definitions.explanation: A needle used for hand sewing, with an eye at one end for thread. From {縫|ぬ}う (to sew) plus {針|はり} (needle).

examples.japanese: {縫|ぬ}い{針|ばり}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{指|ゆび}→指：01518_yubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{刺|さ}して→刺す：02111_sasu⟧しまった。
examples.english: I pricked my finger with a sewing needle.

examples.japanese: ⟦ボタン→ボタン：02963_botan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{縫|ぬ}い{針|ばり}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{糸|いと}→糸：01315_ito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}した→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧。
examples.english: I got a sewing needle and thread ready to attach the button.

notes:
From ⟦{縫|ぬ}う→縫う：00326_nuu⟧ (to sew) plus ⟦{針|はり}→針：03566_hari⟧ (needle); the ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ voices to ば in the compound (rendaku).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {縫|ぬ}い{針|ばり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{糸|いと}→糸：01315_ito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}す→通す：02300_toosu⟧: to thread a sewing needle
- ⟦{太|ふと}い→太い：02955_futoi⟧{縫|ぬ}い{針|ばり}: a thick sewing needle

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{編|あ}み{針|ばり}→編み針：28210_amibari⟧: knitting needle
- {針箱|はりばこ}: sewing box
